answer.text: Fill fuel only till the bottom of the anti splash plate.

watchouts.text: Do not overfill: overfilling can let gasoline enter the EVAP canister and damage the evaporative emission system.
If fuel spills on painted surfaces, wipe it off immediately, as it can leave a permanent stain.
Gasoline vapour is highly explosive. Keep open flames and sparks away, do not smoke while refuelling or with the cap open, and fill in a well-ventilated area.
